name.description: The artifact name, without a directory.

artifact.description: The artifact kind: executable, loadable-module, static-archive, object, or test.

root.description: The absolute path of the root Silk module.

output.description: The absolute path at which the compiler writes the artifact.

stdlib.description: The absolute path of the standard library.

packages.description: Every package used by this compilation, with the root package first.

composition.description: The selected runtime, support modules, and execution-storage bindings.

native.description: The ordered native inputs of the whole compilation.

emit.description: The emitted form: final, llvm-ir, llvm-bitcode, assembly, object, or wasm-text.

platform.description: An explicit sysroot and linker supply, when the target needs one.

header.description: The absolute path of an emitted C header, when requested.

import-library.description: The absolute path of an emitted import library, when requested.

runner.description: The program used to run a foreign artifact or its tests.

description: One complete compilation, with no manifest discovery.

entry.description: The entry selection: default, none, or a declared name.

runtime.description: The runtime selection: default, none, or a declared name.

optimization.description: The program-wide optimization: none, speed, or size.

debug.description: Whether the program emits debug information by default.

backend.description: The code generator: llvm or direct.

codegen-units.description: The number of code generation units for an optimized build.

max-memory.description: The maximum WebAssembly memory, in bytes.

stack-size.description: The main stack size, in bytes.

Profile.description: Program-wide source facts and default backend settings.

directory.description: The absolute package directory used for relative embedded files.

source.description: The absolute root directory of its Silk modules.

dependencies.description: The import aliases and exact package identities they select.

exports.description: The canonical module paths other packages may import.

parameters.description: The declared parameters and their resolved values.

modules.description: Generated modules, with their absolute source paths.

optimization.description: The backend optimization override; source-visible optimization stays program-wide.

Package.description: A resolved source package and the settings its consumer supplied.

package.description: The selected package identity, as name@version.

Dependency.description: An import alias bound to an exact package identity.

module.description: The module that declares the parameter, relative to its package.

type.description: The admitted Silk type of the parameter.

required.description: Whether the declaration has no default.

value.description: The value bound for this compilation.

supplied-path.description: Whether the root supplied this value as a path capability.

Parameter.description: A declared package parameter, including its documentation and bound value.

oneOf.description: An exact decimal integer; its declared type supplies width and signedness.
A member of a named enum.
An ordered sequence of parameter values.

ParameterValue.description: A resolved parameter value. Lists and records preserve their declared element and field types.

ParameterField.description: One named field of a structured parameter.

name.description: The canonical module path inside its package.

source.description: The absolute path of its generated source.

producer.description: The step key that produces the file, for editor diagnostics.

Module.description: A generated module whose source is stored at an explicit path.

runtime.description: The selected startup module, absent for artifacts without a runtime.

support.description: The target support modules rooted by this compilation.

retention.description: Declarations retained regardless of import reachability.

storage.description: The execution-storage operations selected by the runtime.

Composition.description: The resolved runtime composition and exported support modules.

ModuleRef.description: A module identified without a filesystem path.

hosted.description: Whether its C exports are also host exports.

Support.description: A target support module and its export policy.

package.description: The defining package identity, or silk for the standard library.

Selector.description: A declaration rooted by the runtime composition.

sources.description: Native translation units and their compiler arguments.

function-order.description: The absolute path of a function-order file.

Native.description: Ordered native compilation and link inputs.

path.description: The absolute path of the source file.

language.description: The source language: c, cpp, objc, or objcpp.

flags.description: The compiler flags, in argument order.

NativeSource.description: One native translation unit with explicit flags and include paths.

kind.description: The input kind: object, archive, library, framework, search-path, framework-search-path, rpath, or linker-script.

value.description: The library or framework name, or an absolute path for a file or directory input.

mode.description: The library search mode, static or dynamic.

weak.description: Whether the platform may leave this library or framework absent.

needed.description: Whether to retain the library even when no symbol references it.

support.description: Compiler-support installations, each selected by its canonical target triple.

target.description: The canonical target triple served by the installation.

Installation.description: An installed compiler-support directory for one target.

manifest.description: The absolute path of the Windows application manifest.

resources.description: The absolute paths of resource files.

entitlements.description: The absolute path of the signing entitlements.

import-memory.description: Whether memory is supplied by the host.

shared-memory.description: Whether the linear memory is shared.

export-table.description: Whether to export the function table.

execution-model.description: The WASI execution model, command or reactor.

wit.description: The absolute WIT directory for a component build.

world.description: The WIT world name for a component build.

Wasm.description: WebAssembly memory, table, and execution settings.

program.description: The runner executable name or absolute path.

arguments.description: Arguments placed before the artifact path.

Runner.description: A command used to launch a foreign artifact.
